typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source slide 9 / title.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source slide 9 / navSchedule.

recognitionRules: Pair Palatino propositions with Avenir practical detail.
Use forest green and cream with selective earth accents.
Present the practice, feedback and outcome check in a clear sequence.
Keep unpiloted status near the proposed offer.

principles: Use short action sentences; follow an invitation with a concrete material, choice or check.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Give people something to try, and a way to see what changed.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid promises that every participant will master the skill.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Try one version, then compare it with the criterion.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use PRACTICE FIRST in Palatino with a small Avenir sequence number. No graduation cap or achievement star.
invariants: Pair Palatino propositions with Avenir practical detail.
Use forest green and cream with selective earth accents.
Present the practice, feedback and outcome check in a clear sequence.
adaptations: Short offers retain activity, audience and check.
Long proposals add delivery conditions without expanding the promise beyond the evidence.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Palatino is a system or separately licensed font; not bundled.
Avenir Next is a separately licensed Apple/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.
